title: Development and validation of an integrated machine learning model for recurrence-free survival prediction in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
summary: The full text confirms a five-hospital retrospective cohort of 1,284 ccRCC patients with training, internal-validation and independent external-test sets; 3D-ViT and radiomics signatures contributed to RFS prediction, with reported external performance.

evidence.tested: The integrated clinical/radiomics/deep-learning model combined CT features with clinical data; external-test C-index was 0.820 and 3-, 5- and 7-year AUCs were reported.
evidence.unknown: The multicenter retrospective external test supports prognostic discrimination; it does not establish prospective clinical benefit.
